name: Voxel Block Placement with Face Culling
definition: A technique for dynamically updating a voxel chunk's internal state and face visibility when blocks are placed or removed, using neighbor checks to toggle shared faces without regenerating the entire mesh.
summary: Voxel Block Placement with Face Culling dynamically maintains voxel block face visibility using neighbor checks and explicit face toggles, differing from other methods by operating on discrete block indices rather than coverage masks or vertex buffer layouts.
